# Model Router

> Model Router is an open-source plugin for Claude Code that keeps the model and effort Claude names for each subagent, agent-team teammate and workflow stage within the user's cap, fills in the effort when only a model is named, gives a call that names no model a level from its agent's tools, and runs a call marked as a redo with more effort or on a stronger model. It routes among Claude models only (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, Fable) and is not a proxy. An independent project by Cris Nahine (https://github.com/crisnahine), not made or endorsed by Anthropic. Apache-2.0 license. Needs Claude Code 2.1.329 or later and Python 3.9 or later. Site: https://crisnahine.github.io/claude-code-model-router/

Facts, each with its source:

- What Claude is told: a note at session start asks Claude to name `model` and `effort` on every Agent call: Haiku at medium for finding, reading and listing; Haiku at high for writing and fixing code, figures and documents to a brief; Sonnet at high for a judgment call with no check to run (a design or a review); Fable at high for open-ended research. The router never reads the brief to pick a model. Source: plugins/model-router/scripts/modelrouter/hooks.py.
- Levels: lookup on Haiku at medium, standard on Haiku at high, complex on Sonnet at high, hardest on Opus at high, frontier on Fable at high. A model stands for its lowest level (Haiku named at high or above is standard), and one that nobody gave an effort runs at its level's effort, one step more when it is weaker than its level needs. Source: plugins/model-router/config/models.json and plugins/model-router/scripts/modelrouter/ladder.py.
- Who decides the model, first that applies: CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE (the router sets effort only), CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_SUBAGENT_MODEL for a workflow stage whose call names no model (effort only), the model named on the call, a per-agent rule in model-router.json, the agent's own model field (inherit means the parent's model, ahead of CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL), CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL (left alone), then the level the agent's tools put it at: lookup for an agent that can't edit, write or run commands (its tools or disallowedTools leave out Edit, Write, NotebookEdit and Bash, as in Explore and Plan), standard for any other. A rule's level raises that level too. A model from the call, a rule, the agent or its tools is held to max_tier, availableModels, deniedModels and model health, moving to the next stronger usable model, else the strongest usable. A rule's level raises a call, and a teammate starts no lower than standard. Forks are left alone. Source: plugins/model-router/scripts/modelrouter/router.py.
- Redo: a call whose description starts with "Redo:" climbs from the latest finished run of the same agent and description in the session's last 30 minutes, else from what it would run at unmarked: one effort step up on the same model while that run was below high, else the next stronger usable model at its level's effort, else one more effort step. A redo that names a stronger model, or more effort on the same one, runs as named. When CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL, CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT or maxEffortLevel holds the effort, it moves to the next model; under CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL_FORCE only the effort climbs. Workflow stages are never redone. Source: plugins/model-router/scripts/modelrouter/router.py, spawn.py and calls.py.
- The check before a turn ends: with verify_gate on (the default) and routing_mode auto, when a project file changed through Edit, Write or NotebookEdit and no check command ran since, the Stop hook asks Claude once, as additionalContext, for the work's own check. It runs nothing, and it stays quiet while background tasks run or when the transcript can't be read. Source: plugins/model-router/scripts/modelrouter/gates.py.
- Options and storage: three options, routing_mode (auto or off), max_tier (none, haiku, sonnet, opus or fable) and verify_gate (true or false). The ledger in the plugin's data folder keeps each call's agent, level, model, effort and reason, and each subagent's tokens and Claude Code's cost estimate, for up to 30 days and 4 MB. No prompt, brief or description is stored, and the plugin makes no network call. Source: plugins/model-router/.claude-plugin/plugin.json, plugins/model-router/scripts/modelrouter/ledger.py and store.py.
